correctness.rationale: Each subset uniquely gives binary words u and v with u+3v=2(2^m-1). The low target bit is zero, the next m bits are one, and the terminal carry/shift test requires exactly one of the two state bits. Reconstructing the carry transition gives the published matrix (the incoming shifted digit plus carry and both new input digits never force a carry above one). In the suffix series (A,B,B,D) solving (I-tT)^{-1}e, A=tz(A+B), D=tz(B+D), B=1+t(A+z^2 D); hence A=D and t(A+z^2D) is the claimed generating function. A length contribution with j two-step factors has exponent m-1-j+2h; equality to m requires j=2r+1 and h=r+1. Complementation is fixed-point-free. Separately, meet-in-the-middle counting on the actual integer divisor sums and subset sizes reproduced all twelve full spectra and the listed central counts, including m=1 and the first occurrence at m=4.

value.rationale: Balance in cardinality is an established strengthening, and the number of ways to meet it is not captured by existence or total multiplicity. The two-generator divisor family is a standard natural test family. The rational formula determines the complete distribution of sizes, with a fixed-cost recurrence in length and an explicit diagonal count; it is more informative than a list of examples or the previous unweighted count.
